title: 第3章 闪婚祁晏辞
slug: 前任渣我五年闪婚他哥被宠成宝
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这句话一出口，祁晏辞的目光又落在她脸上。

很淡，也很凉。

时夏禾脸有些发烫，可她顾不上难堪。

她需要钱，很需要。

纪枫看了眼祁晏辞，见他没有开口的意思，便公事公办道：“酬劳方面，领证后先付一笔，三年协议到期、和平离婚后，再付尾款。”

说着，他抬起一只手，五指张开。

示意五百万。

包含协议婚姻本身，也包含未来三年里，她需要承担的所有照看、配合和保密义务。

可时夏禾没见过那么多的钱。

她眼睛一亮，理所当然地道：“五十万？”

纪枫：“……”

空气安静了两秒。

祁晏辞端咖啡的手也顿了一下。

时夏禾心里一紧，以为自己猜多了，连忙解释：“我知道五十万不少，但我要跟祁先生假结婚三年，还要随叫随到、配合演戏、照顾他。三年后我也算离过婚的人了，名誉损失、精神损失、劳务费加起来，五十万真的不算多。”

纪枫嘴角抽了抽。

祁晏辞缓缓抬眼看她：“你觉得，你三年只值五十万？”

时夏禾一怔，下意识往高了猜：“难道是……五百万？”

说完她自己都不信，五百万找个假结婚的？直接给彩礼正经娶一个不好吗？

可也不可能是五万，这点钱谁会卖自己三年？

她怕是后者，咬牙道：“五十万不能再少了，祁先生，我真的急用钱。只要今天领证，钱能马上到账，我什么都能配合。”

纪枫忍了又忍，低声提醒：“时小姐，其实祁先生的意思是——”

“纪枫。”祁晏辞打断他，语气淡得听不出情绪，“行，五十万。”

时夏禾如释重负，立刻抓起笔签字。

祁晏辞看着她写下名字，字迹清秀，落笔却很重，像是在逼自己往前走。

他收起协议，起身：“走吧。”

出了咖啡馆，时夏禾跟着祁晏辞坐上了路边的黑色轿车。

车里很安静，空气里有淡淡的冷木香。

时夏禾坐得笔直，手指紧紧攥着帆布包带，不敢乱碰。

纪枫递来二维码：“加一下联系方式，以后生活事项大多由我跟你对接。”

时夏禾赶紧扫码。

赶到民政局时，已经快下班了。

工作人员笑着说：“来得正好，今天最后一对。”

拍照、填表、签字，流程快得像一场梦。

直到红本递到手里，时夏禾还有些恍惚。

昨天她刚结束一段五年的骗局，今天就把自己嫁给了另一个男人。

虽然是假的。

祁晏辞站在她身侧，冷冷问：“后悔了？”

时夏禾回过神，把结婚证递给他：“不后悔。”

后悔是奢侈的事，她连哭的时间都没有，哪来的资格？

手机震了一下，银行到账二十五万。

时夏禾盯着那条短信，眼眶瞬间红了。

“祁先生，纪助理，我还有事先走了，你们有事随时联系我，我一定随叫随到。”

说完她转身跑到路边，扫了一辆共享单车蹬得飞快。

As soon as these words came out, Qi Yanci's eyes fell on her face again.

Very light and very cool.

Shi Xiahe's face felt a little hot, but she couldn't care less about the embarrassment.

She needed money, badly.

Ji Feng glanced at Qi Yanci and saw that he had no intention of speaking, so he said businesslikely: "In terms of remuneration, I will pay an initial payment after receiving the certificate, and the balance will be paid after the three-year agreement expires and the divorce is peaceful."

As he spoke, he raised one hand and spread his fingers.

Indicates five million.

It includes the agreed marriage itself, as well as all the care, cooperation and confidentiality obligations she needs to bear in the next three years.

But Shi Xiahe had never seen so much money.

Her eyes lit up and she said matter-of-factly: "Half a million?"

Ji Feng: "..."

The air was quiet for two seconds.

Qi Yanci's hand holding the coffee paused.

Shi Xiahe's heart tightened, thinking that he had guessed too much, and quickly explained: "I know half a million is a lot, but I have to have a fake marriage with Mr. Qi for three years, and I have to be on call, cooperate in acting, and take care of him. After three years, I will be considered a divorced person. Add up the loss of reputation, mental loss, and labor expenses, and half a million is really not that much."

The corners of Ji Feng's mouth twitched.

Qi Yanci slowly raised his eyes to look at her: "Do you think you are only worth half a million in three years?"

Shi Xiahe was startled and subconsciously guessed higher: "Could it be... five million?"

She didn't even believe it after she said it. Five million to find someone to get married in a fake way?Wouldn't it be better to just give the bride price and marry someone seriously?

But it can't be 50,000. Who would sell himself for three years with this amount of money?

She was afraid that it was the latter, so she gritted her teeth and said: "Five hundred thousand can't be less, Mr. Qi, I'm really in need of money. As long as I get the certificate today and the money can be paid immediately, I can cooperate with anything."

Ji Feng endured it again and again, and reminded in a low voice: "Miss Shi, what Mr. Qi actually means is——"

"Ji Feng." Qi Yanci interrupted him, his tone so calm that no emotion could be heard, "Okay, five hundred thousand."

Shi Xiahe felt relieved and immediately grabbed a pen to sign.

Qi Yanci watched her write her name, her handwriting was delicate but heavy, as if she was forcing herself to move forward.

He put away the agreement and stood up: "Let's go."

After leaving the cafe, Shi Xiahe followed Qi Yanci and got into a black car on the roadside.

It was very quiet in the car, and there was a faint scent of cold wood in the air.

Shi Xiahe sat upright, holding the canvas bag strap tightly with his fingers, not daring to touch it.

Ji Feng handed over the QR code: "Add your contact information, and I will contact you on most life matters from now on."

Shi Xiahe quickly scanned the code.

When I arrived at the Civil Affairs Bureau, it was almost time to get off work.

The staff member smiled and said, "Just in time, the last couple today."

Taking photos, filling out forms, and signing, the process was as fast as a dream.

Until the red book was handed to his hand, Shi Xiahe was still in a daze.

She just ended a five-year scam yesterday and married herself to another man today.

Although it is fake.

Qi Yanci stood beside her and asked coldly: "Do you regret it?"

Shi Xiahe came to his senses and handed him the marriage certificate: "I don't regret it."

Regret is a luxury. She doesn't even have time to cry, so how can she be qualified?

The phone vibrated, and the bank received 250,000 yuan.

Shi Xiahe stared at the text message, his eyes instantly turned red.

"Mr. Qi, Assistant Ji, I have to leave beforehand. If you need anything, please contact me at any time. I will be on call."

After saying that, she turned around and ran to the side of the road, scanned a shared bicycle and pedaled very fast.
